facets.name: Cuisine
facets.description: The culinary tradition of the dish. At most one per recipe; omit if it has no clear tradition.

facets.name: Course
facets.description: Where the dish sits in a meal. One, occasionally two.

facets.name: Main ingredient
facets.description: The dominant protein or staple. Up to two; omit if none stands out.

facets.name: Dietary
facets.description: Only when the recipe as written contains no meat or fish (Vegetarian) or no animal products (Vegan). Never use both.

facets.name: Occasion & style
facets.description: How or when you'd cook it. Only when clearly applicable.
